definitions.gloss: this shop; our store; this restaurant
definitions.explanation: The shop or restaurant that is speaking or being spoken about. Used by staff and on signs, menus and notices to refer to their own establishment.

examples.japanese: {当店|とうてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧です。
examples.english: Smoking is not permitted in this shop.

examples.japanese: {当店|とうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧、⟦ありがとうございます→ありがとうございます：09886_arigatougozaimasu⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for shopping with us.

examples.japanese: {当店|とうてん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦メニュー→メニュー：11166_menyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧です。
examples.english: Our most popular dish is a curry made with local vegetables.

notes:
{当|とう} (this, the said) + ⟦{店|てん}→店：10011_ten⟧ (shop). Customers do not use it of the shop they are in; they say ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧ or ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当店|とうてん}⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧: available only at this store
- {当店|とうてん}⟦おすすめ→おすすめ：09746_osusume⟧: house recommendation
- {当店|とうてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ご⟦{利用|りよう}→利用：01752_riyou⟧⟦いただき→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧: (thank you) for using our store

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弊店|へいてん}: our humble store (more humble, in letters and formal notices)
- ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧: our company; {当館|とうかん}: this hall, this hotel
